title: Percentage of Completion Method - Revenue Recognition

content.definition: Revenue recognition method for long-term contracts where revenue recognized over time based on progress toward completion
content.asc_606_context: Under ASC 606, recognize revenue OVER TIME if meets criteria (control transfers over time). Percentage of completion is application of over-time recognition.
content.when_used: Long-term construction contracts, software development, other long-term projects where performance obligation satisfied over time
content.formula: % Complete = Costs incurred to date / Total estimated costs. Revenue to date = % Complete × Contract price. Current period revenue = Revenue to date - Prior periods' revenue.

methods_to_measure_progress.cost_to_cost: Costs incurred / Total estimated costs (most common)

year_1.calculate: % Complete, Revenue to date, Gross profit to date
year_1.entry: DR Construction in Progress (costs), CR Materials/Payables/Cash. DR CIP (profit), DR AR (or Cash), CR Revenue, CR CIP (if billings > revenue)

accounting_steps.subsequent_years: Cumulative catch-up: Revenue to date - Prior revenue = Current year revenue

losses_on_contracts.loss_in_current_period: If costs exceed revenue for period, recognize loss (can happen even if contract overall profitable)

loss_on_entire_contract.if_total_costs_exceed_price: Recognize ENTIRE estimated loss immediately (in current period)
loss_on_entire_contract.formula: Loss = Total estimated costs - Contract price
loss_on_entire_contract.example: Contract $1M, estimated total costs $1.1M. Recognize $100K loss immediately, even if only started.

loss_example.facts: Contract $1M, Year 1 costs $300K, revised total estimated costs $1.2M (loss of $200K expected)

year_1.additional_loss: Entire contract loss $200K. Recognize additional $150K loss immediately.

construction_in_progress.balance_sheet_account: CIP = Cumulative costs + Cumulative gross profit - Billings
construction_in_progress.if_cip_gt_billings: Asset: CIP in excess of billings (or Contract asset)
construction_in_progress.if_billings_gt_cip: Liability: Billings in excess of CIP (or Contract liability)

billings_vs_revenue.billings: Amount invoiced to customer (not necessarily revenue)
billings_vs_revenue.entry_for_billing: DR AR, CR Billings on Contract

completed_contract_method.not_gaap: No longer acceptable under ASC 606 (was allowed previously if couldn't estimate)
completed_contract_method.recognize_at_completion: All revenue and costs recognized when contract complete (not over time)

cpa_exam_tips: % Complete = Costs incurred to date / Total estimated costs
Current year revenue = Revenue to date - Prior years' revenue
Loss on entire contract: Recognize ENTIRE loss immediately (don't spread)
CIP = Costs + Profit - Billings. If positive = asset. If negative = liability.
Completed contract method NOT allowed under ASC 606

calculation_approach: 1. Calculate % complete (costs to date / total est costs)
3. GP to date = Revenue to date - Costs to date
4. Current year = To date - Prior years
cpa_exam_strategies.loss_recognition: If total estimated costs > contract price: Recognize ENTIRE loss immediately
common_mistakes: Using prior year's % complete (recalculate each year cumulatively)
Not recognizing entire contract loss immediately (spreading it over periods)
Forgetting to subtract prior years' revenue for current year amount

key_points: % Complete = Costs incurred to date / Total estimated costs
Revenue = % Complete × Contract price (cumulative, then subtract prior years)
Entire contract loss: Recognize immediately (don't defer)
CIP = Costs + Profit - Billings (asset if positive, liability if negative)
Billings ≠ Revenue (billings are invoices, revenue based on progress)
Completed contract method NOT allowed under ASC 606
